CustomField.description: To be used for Account Review case calculating the duration between the Review Period Start and End Date
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Review_Period_Start_Date__c)),(TEXT(IF(NOT(ISBLANK( Review_Period_Start_Date__c )) && NOT(ISBLANK( Review_Period_End_Date__c )) ,(((YEAR(Review_Period_End_Date__c ) - YEAR( Review_Period_Start_Date__c ) - 1) *12) + (12 - MONTH( Review_Period_Start_Date__c ) +1) + MONTH(Review_Period_End_Date__c)) , null )))&" months", "")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Duration of the Review Period Start and End Date entered
CustomField.label: Review Period Duration
